heading_path: Division 2—Proceedings before the Registrar or a court
text: In an action or proceeding relating to a trade mark, evidence is admissible of the usage of the trade concerned and of any relevant trade mark, trade name or get-up legitimately used by other persons.
title: Evidence of trade usage
